questions.topicName: 机器学习与深度学习基础
questions.question: 在遥操作数据上做行为克隆存在一个众所周知的失效模式。它是什么？在真实人形机器人上你如何应对？
questions.questionEn: Behaviour cloning on teleoperation data has a well-known failure mode. What is it, and what do you do about it on a real humanoid?

questions.topicName: 机器学习与深度学习基础
questions.question: 一个完全在仿真中训练的全身控制器必须运行在真实硬件上。哪些能迁移，哪些不能，你如何弥补这个差距？
questions.questionEn: A whole-body controller trained entirely in simulation has to run on real hardware. What transfers, what does not, and how do you close the gap?

questions.topicName: 机器学习与深度学习基础
questions.question: 在操作任务中，强化学习如何叠加在模仿学习之上？为什么奖励是最难的部分？
questions.questionEn: Where does reinforcement learning fit on top of imitation learning for manipulation, and what makes the reward the hard part?

questions.topicName: 推理、服务与 GPU 性能
questions.question: 一位同事想把语义层搬到云端，以便使用大得多的模型。请讲一讲延迟预算。
questions.questionEn: A colleague wants to move the semantic layer to the cloud so you can use a much bigger model. Walk me through the latency budget.

questions.question: 设计遥操作数据管线。为什么在机器人领域，瓶颈是数据采集而不是算力？
questions.questionEn: Design the teleoperation data pipeline. Why is data collection the bottleneck in robotics rather than compute?

questions.question: 对于一个新任务，你有 10 小时的示范数据，以及再采集 50 小时的预算。你如何决定采集什么？预期能获得什么回报？
questions.questionEn: You have 10 hours of demonstrations for a new task and budget for 50 more. How do you decide what to collect, and what return do you expect?

questions.question: 当每次试验都要消耗机器人的时间、且每次失败都会带来物理后果时，你如何评估一个操作策略？
questions.questionEn: How do you evaluate a manipulation policy when every trial costs robot time and every failure has physical consequences?

questions.question: 你把一个策略部署到 300 台机器人。它在实验室里能用，到了现场却性能下降。请排查。
questions.questionEn: You ship a policy to 300 robots. It works in the lab and degrades in the field. Debug it.

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 为在人员附近运行的学习型全身策略设计安全架构。
questions.questionEn: Design the safety architecture for a learned whole-body policy operating near people.

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: 什么是 vision-language-action 模型？它与带工具的 LLM 有何不同？
questions.questionEn: What is a vision-language-action model, and how is it different from an LLM with tools?

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: Helix 拆分为一个大的慢模型和一个小而快的模型。为什么不直接跑一个单一的端到端网络？
questions.questionEn: Helix splits into a large slow model and a small fast one. Why not run a single end-to-end network?

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: 解释 action chunking。为什么要预测未来的一系列动作，而不是只预测下一个动作？
questions.questionEn: Explain action chunking. Why predict a sequence of future actions instead of the next one?
